''''Boat'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can be obtained by [[Fishing#Presents|fishing]] at the southwest spot of the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]].

This spot can be accessed at the left of the southwest pond. There is a hidden path downwards that gives access to the sea. The first time fishing there will always result in obtaining the painting.<ref name="boatchance" /> Only one painting can be obtained per player per game.

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
